newsitem.title: CANADA: Motorola locates new division in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Motorola locates new division in Canada.

text.p: Motorola Inc said on Tuesday it was locating the global headquarters of its new Network Systems Division in Mississauga, Ontario.
The division was expanding its focus from product development and global marketing for the Vanguard network products to include U.S. sales and world customer service.
New products have been added to the development portfolio and now include corporate modems and bandwidth and network management systems.

With the new division, Canadian employment levels of 150 will be sharply expanded, as will research and development spending, over the next few years, according to Graham Pattison, vice president of the new division.
"We'll be adding a significant amount of people," said Pattison. "We expect pretty rapid market growth."
Design centers in Huntsville, Alabama, Mansfield, Massachusetts and India will report to the Mississauga headquarters, the company said.
The company said it chose Mississauga because of its access to universities, superb transportation and communications systems and a diverse population.
